note: 'colour bar thinner' is written as one nominal whose head is the grading word 'thinner', so the thing graded and the word that grades it are the same name.
'colour bar thinner' holds 'thinner' as a dependent of 'bar', so the word becomes part of the description by which the bar is found instead of saying how it should be.
'to' in 'set the grid lines to in both directions' is held as a modifier of the clause, although it is the linking word that carries the value the lines are set to.
'see-through' in 'markers see-through' is no verb here, but the circuit makes it the verb of a nonfinite clause.
'to' in 'set the x axis label to on the top' stands as a modifier, a linking word with no link, and the first request is left tied to nothing in the message.
'to' in 'set the tick spacing to in steps of two' is a modifier, so the linking word that carries the value stands with no relation.
'the ticks dener' is one nominal whose head is the grading word 'dener', so the word that says how the ticks should be names them instead.
'smlaler' is made the head of a nominal of its own in 'x axis numbers smlaler', so the grading word becomes a thing named instead of a word about the numbers.
'to' in 'set the tick numbers to at the top and on the right' is held as a modifier, so the linking word that carries the place has no relation of its own.
the coordination joins 'at the top' with 'on the revenue trend', but the words join 'at the top' and 'on the right' as the two places of the tick numbers.
'on the right' starts at the clause of 'that's the tweak', so the second place is not joined with 'at the top' as what the tick numbers should be.
'point' in 'point where the axes cross at zero' is held as a noun in a fragment, so the command is lost where the first word can be its verb.
'where' in 'the point where the axes cross to at zero' is made a nominal and the 'to' of 'to at zero' is tied to it, so the link from the verb to the value is wrong.
'point' in 'point where the axes cross at zero again' is held as a noun in a fragment, so the command is lost where the first word can be its verb.
'where' in 'the point where the axes cross to at zeero' is made a nominal and the 'to' of 'to at zeero' is tied to it, so the link from the verb to the value is wrong.
'error bars' is split into two nominals, 'error' and 'bars', so the message is made to name two things to display.
